outcome_verbatim: Track live hazards online; interpret data.
common_finish: Keep your own A–C plots, the newest record with its date, a magnitude comparison, a depth comparison with km, and one valid limit. Label H as historic if you use it.

research.title: Significant world earthquakes in the last 60 days
research.snapshot_scope: Three selected observed October 2026 earthquake records, frozen for offline data practice. This is not a complete event list or a live feed.
research.catalogue_caution: Locations and magnitudes may be revised after further analysis. Values below belong to the frozen BGS snapshot. Magnitude and depth do not alone determine impacts.

research.title: What is the difference between earthquake magnitude and earthquake intensity? What is the Modified Mercalli Intensity Scale?
research.scope: Magnitude and impact are different concepts; shaking and impact depend on several factors.

research.note: Historic baseline, not one of the recent October 2026 records. Use USGS values consistently; JMA publishes its own M9.0/depth24km solution.
